Sara: heads up — quick follow-up from the token validation postmortem earlier. I sketched a remediation plan and timelines, want alignment.
Ben: thanks. can you drop the list? i'll take ownership for the permissions audit item if that's ok.
Sara: yep. main items: 1) token validation library bump + integration tests (2w) owner: Jordan, 2) secrets rotation automation for service accounts (3w) owner: Kevin, 3) audit logging gaps + retention policy (1w) owner: Ben, 4) recurring incident pattern analysis + alert tuning (2w) owner: Sara.
Jordan: added — I can start tomorrow. do we have a target branch or should i work off authz-v2?
Sara: work off authz-v2, create a draft PR and link the test harness. include these commands in CI:

```
pytest tests/auth/token_validation_test.py::TestTokenExpiry
scripts/check-token-headers.sh
```

Ben: noted. for audit logging, i need a list of endpoints missing payloads; can someone paste the query?
Kevin: AuditBot can run the ELK query — @AuditBot could you run the "missing_audit_payloads" query and post top 10 services?
AuditBot: Running query: missing_audit_payloads — results queued. Top services: inference-router, session-manager, gateway-proxy, token-service, admin-console.
Jordan: good signal. i think token-service is the biggest pain here.
Ben: i'll own audit logging fixes for those top services; will set retention to 90d and add structured payloads by end of next week.
Kevin: for secrets rotation automation, plan is: 1) catalog service accounts, 2) create rotation lambda, 3) integrate with KMS/HSM, 4) schedule weekly roll for high-risk keys. timeline 3w but can do faster if we parallelize.
Sara: please add ETA to the tracker and mark blockers. also create a follow-up meeting to sync weekly — provisional: Wednesdays 10am PT.
Ben: added tasks to JIRA: LINK: https://our-jira/RED-1234 (perm-audit-fixes). set sprint: postmortem-remed-2025-04
Jordan: putting up a draft PR now: https://github.com/redwood/authz/pull/487 — tests failing on one vector, investigating.
Kevin: i'll prep the secret rotation lambda repo and hand off a template by EOD Friday.
Sara: thanks all. action items recap (brief): Jordan -> token lib + tests (2w), Ben -> audit logging + retention (1w), Kevin -> secrets rotation automation (3w), Sara -> pattern analysis + alerts (2w). owners please update the remediation board and ping if timelines slip. :thumbsup:
Ben: done, board updated. created the recurring issue for runbook updates.
Jordan: PR green, merging to authz-v2 after CI passes. will flag if anything blocks.
Kevin: template pushed to repo: https://github.com/redwood/rotations - will open PR for infra changes next week.
Sara: closing thread for now — we'll use the weekly sync for status. thanks everyone.
